newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding via 5-day or overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding via 5-day or overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve was expected to inject reserves into the banking system through either overnight or five-day system repurchase agreements on Wednesday.
The Fed on Tuesday added $2.10 billion in reserves via overnight system RPs.
Analysts forecast about a $6 billion a day add need in the maintenance period that ends August 13.
One Fed watcher said that if the Fed is uncertain about the reserve outlook, it may just do overnight system RPs, although the Fed will likely want to add through five-days.
In early trading, federal funds were trading at 5-7/16 percent, below the Fed's 5-1/2 percent target rate.
